coverage.classificationBasis: Frozen packet summaries, command receipts and producer dispositions; no gameplay reruns or whole-source certification.
notes: Audit covers the current recovered ledger and batches v91 onward; older physical-attempt denominators are unavailable.
Five admitted discoveries are sparse samples; operational markers are not randomized strategy experiments and do not establish causality.
Matched tasks can miss their requested target; parity is not proof of target reach or novelty.
Worker-ledger activity does not itself publish a dashboard snapshot; snapshot/publication cadence can lag new results.

Bug-family IDs here identify distinct supported source-traced first causes, not unrelated subsystems. At this audit, the five first causes span three broader mechanisms: message/formatting, repeated macro evaluation of RNG, and merged-state representation.
